implemented: Feedback DAX IQ picker lists only original-GUI owned, center-observed pans with assigned IQ channels 1..4. Selection is explicit, transient and sends no radio command. Channel or owner changes clear the selection; ordinary readback updates preserve it without resetting the dropdown model.

Start carries the exact channel and pan through RadioModel session/ownership checks and the HTTP client to authenticated POST /v2/aetherpd/start. Unsupported selected start is refused without legacy channel1 fallback.

Desktop pins requested and subsequently observed binding to the original session. Missing, mismatched or failed binding cannot revive from a late matching reply. Explicit terminal Stop/new Start permits a new binding.
Observed native binding is displayed separately from the requested selection. No new privilege, RF command, stream assignment, saved radio configuration or automatic rearm.
